// diagnostic

E0918

`#Inline(Always) fn` had its address taken instead of being called directly

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` had its address taken instead of being called directly

Why

`#Inline(Always)` guarantees every direct call is inlined on every tier, and a function value has no call site to copy into. Sema refuses each mark that can't keep the guarantee: a call of itself or a cycle of marked calls (E0917), a use as a value (E0918), a body over the size ceiling (E0919), `#Scrub` (E1016), a read of `context.trace` (E1017) and a foreign body (E1021)

Fix

Call the `#Inline(Always)` function directly or relax the marker before taking its address.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0918: Tests/UI/inline_always_address_taken.stderr.

Error [jet.InlineAlwaysAddressTaken]: `triple` cannot be inlined: its address is taken
  --> Tests/UI/inline_always_address_taken.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | #Inline(Always) triple: fn(x: Int) -> Int { return x * 3 }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `triple` is also used as a plain value somewhere (stored, returned, or passed as a callback), and a value needs a real function to point at. `#Inline(Always)` guarantees that every direct call is inlined on every tier, or the program is refused: sema refuses a function that calls itself or closes a cycle of marked calls (E0917), one used as a value (E0918), one over the size ceiling (E0919), a `#Scrub` routine (E1016), one that reads `context.trace` (E1017) and one with a foreign body (E1021).
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)`, or call `triple` directly instead of through a value.
